description: Unit tests for net::HostResolverInternalResult and its subclasses, testing serialization, deserialization, and correctness of different result types (data, metadata, error, alias).

classes.name: HostResolverInternalResult
classes.description: Base class for different types of host resolver results (data, metadata, error, alias).

classes.name: HostResolverInternalDataResult
classes.description: Represents a successful DNS data result with domain, query type, endpoints, strings, and hosts.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalMetadataResult
classes.description: Represents DNS metadata result with connection endpoint metadata.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalErrorResult
classes.description: Represents an error result with error code.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalAliasResult
classes.description: Represents an alias result pointing to another domain.

methods.name: FromValue
methods.description: Deserializes a base::Value into a specific HostResolverInternalResult subclass.

methods.name: ToValue
methods.description: Serializes the result into a base::Value for logging or storage.

methods.name: domain_name
methods.description: Returns the domain name associated with the result.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of result (data, metadata, error, alias).

methods.name: source
methods.description: Returns the source of the DNS result.

methods.name: AsData
methods.description: Returns the object as a HostResolverInternalDataResult if type is data.

methods.name: AsMetadata
methods.description: Returns the object as a HostResolverInternalMetadataResult if type is metadata.

methods.name: AsError
methods.description: Returns the object as a HostResolverInternalErrorResult if type is error.

methods.name: AsAlias
methods.description: Returns the object as a HostResolverInternalAliasResult if type is alias.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns the error code for error results.

methods.name: alias_target
methods.description: Returns the alias target domain for alias results.
